title: Prove to Earn Agent
tagline: Autonomous agents that discover, execute and complete Prove to Earn quests for users.
description: Prove to Earn Agent is an extension of P2E Inferno, our live Prove to Earn platform on Base. Today, users manually discover and complete onchain Daily Quest tasks. During ETHOnline, we are building an agent gateway and autonomous runner that lets a human authorize an AI agent once, then have that agent discover eligible quests, decide whether to act, execute supported onchain tasks from its own wallet, submit proof, claim rewards and complete the quest on the owner’s behalf.
how_its_made: We are extending P2E Inferno’s existing Daily Quest engine rather than replacing it. The new agent gateway introduces owner-to-agent delegation, wallet-signature authentication, scoped and revocable permissions, typed API responses and x402-paid endpoints. A CDP AgentKit runner uses its own EOA wallet, The Graph informs execution decisions, and a custom Uniswap action preserves P2E Inferno’s existing Universal Router and fee path. World AgentKit proof-of-human is integrated into API pricing. Base is where the agent executes the onchain action. P2E Inferno’s existing Daily Quest verification logic checks that the submitted transaction satisfies the quest requirements, EAS provides verifiable attestations for task claims, and Unlock mints the final quest-completion key to the human owner.
auto_summary: An agent gateway and runner delegates quest execution to an AI-controlled wallet that discovers, performs, and verifies onchain tasks for a user.
